text:
nina: Quick heads-up — planning to deploy SDK v10 to prod next Tue 10:00 PT (2026-04-07). Main user-facing changes: method rename client.create -> client.build() and small auth header tweak (X-Redwood-Client -> X-RW-Client). Please flag any blockers by EOD Fri. PR with migration guide: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/pull/412 :wave:

kai: +1. Are we doing a phased canary or full roll? I suggest phased 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 30m observation windows.

oliver: phased sgtm. I'll own canary health checks for the runtime side. Will run the usual token throughput and tail-latency dashboards.

nina: sweet — owners: kai (deployment orchestration), oliver (runtime smoke), sophie (client libs & docs), raj (rollback/oncall).

sophie: I can cut the client compat patch and update the changelog. Will open a small patch to keep v9 adapters working for one release. Also prepping a short note for customers.

raj: oncall that morning 09:30-12:30 PT, can be available for rollback. If we need to revert, what's our rollback point?

nina: rollback plan: revert the deploy tag and re-route traffic to v9 model variant for API compatibility. Backup tag: sdk-v9-stable-20260401. Need staging promotion tested before cut.

deploy-bot: Deploy window scheduled: 2026-04-07T17:00:00Z -> 2026-04-07T18:30:00Z (10:00-11:30 PT). Canary steps added to infra runbook.

kai: Smoke checklist (quick):
- run integration smoke on staging using sdk-v10 build
- run e2e token budget test (30s high qps)
- verify streaming responses for chat endpoints
- confirm header auth still accepted by gateway

oliver: Adding runtime checks:
- KV cache warmup verified in canary pods
- tail p99 < 300ms for gen endpoints
- no OOMs in last 2 deploys

sophie: client-side smoke (commands):
```bash
# quick sanity against canary backend
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -H "X-RW-Client: sdk-v10-test" \
  https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
# expect 200 and JSON with "text" field
```

nina: also will send an internal customer comms draft by Tue AM and a short migration snippet for the changelog. Sophie will review.

kai: tagging @eng-sre for visibility. Any infra capacity concerns?

oliver: infra looks fine for planned QPS. We have burst headroom in us-west-2.

raj: :thumbsup: all set from oncall side. I'll keep the rollback steps handy and a runbook on pagerduty.

nina: ok — summary actions:
- sophie: finalize client compat patch + changelog (due Mon EOD)
- kai: deploy plan and phased traffic policy (due Mon EOD)
- oliver: runtime smoke scripts + dashboards (due Tue 08:00 PT)
- raj: rollback/runbook verify (due Mon EOD)

nina: thanks everyone. Ping here if anything blocks. :pray:
